what: A one-screen room with no scrolling. Each wheel notch (deltaY 280), arrow key, swipe or thumbnail press moves on to the next panel. The new panel opens from the center with clip inset(50%) → 0, delayed .2s, over .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). The panel just before it stays behind and grows to 1.2x over .9s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), and the room background changes to that panel’s color (--fx-tone) in .45s ease-out. The side thumbnail strip pushes the current panel’s thumbnail to the center in .55s and lights up only that cell’s color. Pressing a panel toggles zoom (is-zoom) on and off, and over a panel a cursor label (Zoom) follows the cursor.

options.per: Wheel distance to turn one page (px), default 280
options.start: Starting panel index (from 0) or random (original: any panel each time it opens)
options.--fx-open · --fx-delay · --fx-settle · -: (css variables) open .7s · delay .2s · back panel .9s · background .45s · band .55s
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Panel — --fx-tone in style is that panel’s room background color
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Frame where panels stack up (click to enlarge)
options.[data-fx-part=strip] · thumb: (If present) thumbnail strip and cells — the strip’s parent is the visible window
options.[data-fx-part=label]: (if present) cursor name tag — data-in · data-out text
options.fx:change: Detail from the element on each flip { index, count, first } Fires it — used to change the number and title
options.intro: If open, the first panel also starts by opening from the center (Brand), otherwise the first panel stays as it is
options.auto: Moves to the next panel by itself every N seconds, default 0 (off) — recounts when moved by hand and rests while zoomed in. The reference site uses 5

from.where: studies.html .st (11 works on one screen — original studies-mask-reveal .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) .2s · studies-backdrop-settle .9s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) 1→1.2 · backdrop 450ms ease-out · band 550ms · wheel deltaY/280 · Zoom label 250ms)

note: Since it hijacks the wheel (preventDefault), use it only in one-screen rooms with no scroll. On non-touch devices, pushing more than 40px up or down moves on (a press is not intercepted).
